title: Resolution urging MTA to deck LIRR tracks in Queens
summary: This resolution calls on the Metropolitan Transportation Authority to start a capital project to build a deck over parts of the Long Island Rail Road Port Washington Branch open cut between Flushing and Murray Hill, Queens. The open cut runs about 4,100 feet and 4.35 acres and currently divides the neighborhoods, causing dumping and maintenance issues. The Council wants the MTA to study and advance a project creating public space, better connectivity and possibly parking above the tracks.
